Kings County New York Inmate Lookup — Official Guide

Finding inmate information in Kings County, New York requires knowing where to look and understanding the available resources. This guide walks you through the official channels for conducting an inmate lookup in Kings County, which encompasses Brooklyn and operates under the New York City Department of Correction.

How to Search Kings County Jail Records

  1. Visit the NYC Department of Correction's official inmate lookup portal online
  2. Enter the inmate's full name or booking number if you have it
  3. Specify the facility (Kings County holds inmates at multiple locations including the Brooklyn House of Detention)
  4. Review the search results, which typically display housing location, charges, and bail information
  5. Contact the facility directly by phone if you need additional details not available online
  6. Request records in writing if you need official documentation for legal purposes

Official Kings County Resources

  • NYC Department of Correction Official Website — Central hub for inmate information
  • Kings County Criminal Court — Court records and case information
  • Brooklyn District Attorney's Office — Prosecution records and case status
  • Kings County Sheriff's Office — Civil and criminal enforcement information
  • Legal Aid Society — Free legal assistance for qualifying individuals
  • New York State Department of Corrections — For inmates transferred to state facilities

Bail Information for Kings County New York

Bail in Kings County is determined by a judge during an arraignment hearing, typically within 24 hours of arrest. The amount depends on factors including criminal history, flight risk, employment status, and ties to the community. Defendants can pay bail directly, use a bail bondsman (who typically charges 10% of the bail amount), or request bail be waived by the judge. Kings County also participates in the New York Pretrial Services program, which may allow release on own recognizance for eligible individuals. Understanding your bail options and rights is crucial, and consulting with a criminal defense attorney is strongly recommended.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I search Kings County jail records by booking number?

Yes, searching by booking number is often the fastest way to locate an inmate. The NYC Department of Correction assigns a unique booking number at intake, and this number helps distinguish individuals with similar names.

How long does it take for Kings County inmate information to appear online?

Most inmate records appear in the online system within 2-4 hours after booking. However, during high-volume periods, it may take longer. Calling the facility directly can provide faster results.

What if I cannot find an inmate in the Kings County system?

If an inmate doesn't appear in Kings County records, they may have been transferred to a state facility, released, or charges may have been dropped. Contact the Kings County Criminal Court or call the Brooklyn House of Detention at the listed facility phone number for assistance.
